THOUSANDS IN EVACUATION CENTERS AFTER FIRE HITS MANILA COMMUNITY

More than 2,000 families were affected by the fire in Parola Compound, San Nicolas in Binondo, Manila, the Manila local government unit (LGU) said.

According to a spot report sent at 11:59 a.m. on Sunday, May 24, the Manila LGU said that 2,134 families were affected by the fire. This translates to 7,123 individuals.

MORE THAN 2,100 FAMILIES AFFECTED IN BINONDO FIRE

UPDATE: At least 2,134 families were affected by the massive fire that hit Parola Compound in Binondo, Manila on Saturday, according to the latest report by the Manila Department of Social Welfare. 

Meanwhile, Mayor Isko Moreno said the Manila city government is preparing around P15 million worth of financial assistance for families displaced by the blaze.
